title: Phases of a clocked simulation
statement: For state types $SS$ and $AS$, define the clock phase to be one of: a boot phase carrying a yardstick machine state; either of two rewind phases; a run phase carrying an optional attempt-machine state and an optional captured value in $none, none, some	ext{-valued Boolean}$; or one of three reset-sweep phases, in leftward, rightward, then leftward order.
